notes.title: Guild & Gals, our upcoming managerial harem game for adults has been approved!
notes.content:
[h1]Guild & Gals has been approved![/h1]

Guild & Gals, our upcoming managerial harem game for adults has been approved for Steam!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1653230/Guild__Gals/

Guild & Gals is a game where you manage a huge roster of mercenaries, undertaking dangerous missions with adaptive AI for your mercenaries with huge boobs! 

Numerous mercenaries to recruit, each with their own unique personalities! 

Shower your mercenaries with gifts and raise your relationships to build friendships or even deeper relationships!


[h2]Wishlist the game today![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1653230/Guild__Gals/
